verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a REST API and an MCP server, but the evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index and MCP server are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
